description:
Systems thinking, a skill often developed over years by senior developers, is now essential from day one in a world where artificial intelligence generates code. This shift highlights the critical role of system thinking in modern software engineering, especially when dealing with AI coding tools. As a developer with over 20 years of experience in coding and software development, I'm sharing insights on navigating this new landscape.

In this video:
- What systems thinking actually is and why it's the one coding skill AI can't write for you 
- The three questions every builder should answer before shipping any line of code (state, feedback, deletion) 

Timestamps:
00:00 — Intro
00:46 — Why we've been focused on the wrong skill
03:14 — What a system actually is (orchestra vs conductor)
04:20 — The shift to the new literacy
05:22— The three questions every builder should answer
07:43 — Why AI isn't the next abstraction layer
09:22 — The industry broke the junior pipeline
12:03 — The discipline gap (fast food vs the craft)
14:00 — The generalist shift
16:00 — For every builder: juniors, seniors, non-techs
19:08 — Four moves to train systems thinking

🎬 Previous video mentioned: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cv6rwHTGT5w
Join a community of builders: https://thefabery.com
—
About me
I'm Hak. Engineer turned founder. I build AI-native software and share what I learn here. No hype. Just real lessons from the trenches. Subscribe if that's your thing.
—
Work with me: https://agentivestack.ai/services
X: https://x.com/mostlyhak
LI: https://linkedin.com/in/mostlyhak
—
Sources: 
📄 Peter Naur — Programming as Theory Building (1985): https://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~remzi/Naur.pdf
